key_decisions: MPI-198 CAN be proven with ZERO download and ZERO compute. isCompleteOnDisk (routes/downloadCompletion.js:16-18) is EXISTENCE-ONLY - no size, no hash - and ComfyUI validates value_not_in_list as enum membership at /prompt BEFORE reading any weight. So four zero-byte .safetensors at the right paths make the app treat Wan 2.2 5B as installed, the dispatch validates for real, and a 200 + prompt_id is the proof. Execution then fails instantly loading an empty file, which costs nothing on a thermally-limited box.

Wan 2.2 5B was chosen over Klein and Krea 2 because it needs the FEWEST files (4 vs Klein's 15 vs Krea 2's ~19), not because it is smallest to download (it is 17.2GB vs Klein 13.56GB - irrelevant when nothing is downloaded). Klein's 8 style LoRAs would all have to exist or a missing placeholder is indistinguishable from a heal failure.

SDXL CANNOT prove MPI-198 - swept every template in comfy_workflows/: only klein, krea2, ltx, wan5b, qwen bake backslashed loader values. Every SDXL path is flat. The user's existing 6.7GB of SDXL is useless for this.

The masking auto-detect graph CANNOT prove MPI-198 either - img_auto_mask.json has zero backslashes (bbox/face_yolov8n.pt is forward-slash, the other two are bare filenames). It IS a good cheap engine-works smoke (sam-vit-b 367MB + face-yolov8n 6MB) for checklist line 95, which nothing has proven on Linux.

What MPI-198 actually adds is ONE line: _needsPathHeal (comfyController.js:91-94) returns true at line 92 for remote (every Pod run ever, already proven) and the NEW branch is line 93, `_serverPlatform !== '' && !== 'win32'`. The heal loop below is shared and battle-tested. The only untested input is whether _serverPlatform reads 'linux' on a real Linux host.

MpiStyleLoras keeps ALL five baked lora_1..lora_5 values in the dispatched prompt regardless of which style is selected (comfyController.js:1297-1301) - the selector picks at runtime. So style racks always carry their backslashes.
A WARM-CACHE LAUNCH CANNOT TEST MPI-407. The first launch after extracting bound the server in 0.8s and proved nothing. Any re-test must drop caches or cold-boot.

Each step of _provisionUvEngine carries its OWN idempotency and they are NOT interchangeable: 0b deletes, step 1 clears, step 3 restores. MPI-408 shipped a changelog promising 'Retry now works' on the strength of one step, and it did not. Walk the whole sequence.

MPI-406's lesson: 'sweep the blast radius' applies to STAGES OF THE SAME INSTALL, not only to call sites of a shared function. Stage tags in app.log are how you tell them apart - [comfy-install] vs [system] [pip] are different stages with different root causes.
app.log ROTATES (logger.js:16-17) and the giant pip output blows past the cap easily. Always grep app.log AND app.log.1 or you will read an empty result as a failed dispatch.
The Linux box has NO curl. Use engine/comfy-venv/bin/python3 with urllib, or read files directly.
